name: Massachusetts Rail Trail Challenge
howToGet:
- Create an account on this site (hiking-patches.com)
- Hike, run, bike, roll 100 miles from the rail trails listed below.
- The miles must be unique in that you can't count hiking the same trail more than once.
- Record your miles below (after creating an account).
- You can record hikes you've done in the past. Just guesstimate the date if you can't remember.
- Once you reach 100 miles, the "Get the Patch" button will be enable where you can make your payment ($15) and provide your address so we can send you your patch.
###
